summary: HUD speed readout formatter. Selects one of two speed-magnitude accessors on the byte_7D0474 encoding flag, formats the returned magnitude as a zero-padded 3-digit integer via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck("%.3d"), then renders the resulting buffer to the display resource at this+0x10 (+84) through sub_553070.

local_names.v2: speed magnitude integer from the selected accessor
local_names.v4: stack buffer holding the formatted "%.3d" text
local_names.display: display resource context pointer at this+0x10

operations.description: Branch on the encoding flag byte_7D0474: when non-zero read the speed magnitude via SpeedMagnitude, otherwise via SpeedMagnitude_b950.
Call SpeedMagnitude (0x0049B900) or SpeedMagnitude_b950 (0x0049B950) to obtain the current speed magnitude integer.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck formats the magnitude into the stack buffer with the "%.3d" format literal at 0x005CCEC8 (a3d).
Render the formatted buffer through sub_553070 with size 4, value 43, and the render target sub-object read from this+0x10 at offset +84.
Return the result of sub_553070. Invoked from SteeringWheelAnimation (0x0049D070) on the steering/HUD update path.
